items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: And on this side was the house that I was living in. It was German folks living there. Ms. Selsa and her brother and her mother.

ctx.x: Yeah, well we stayed there. Yeah, we stayed there. That was a real nice neighborhood. It was a mixed neighborhood. Across the street was the Caucasians. And on this side was the house that I was living in. It was German folks living there. Ms. Selsa and her brother and her mother. And after they all died out, that's when Ms. Richard, who was next door to me, she told me. They didn't ever put a for sale sign on us. But she talked with the lady and we made an offer. And the brothers, they wanted a few dollars more.…
What year were you married? I don't think you told me.
